deadline.value: The 2027/28 main round closes at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong time. Later applications may be considered if places remain. HKPFS registration with the RGC is due by noon on the same date.

also.quote: Applications received after the above-mentioned deadline may be considered subject to the availability of student places.
Applicants must first register on the RGC’s Online Application System (OAS) and obtain a reference number before 1 December 2026 (12:00 noon Hong Kong time).
* at 11:59 p.m. (Hong Kong Time or GMT +8 hours)

gre_subject.value: No distinct GRE Subject Test policy was identified on the programme or central pages checked.

supervisor.value: The graduate application checklist instructs applicants to find a potential supervisor and seek consent.
supervisor.quote: Search for a potential supervisor and seek consent

funding.value: Eligible full-time applicants are considered on academic merit. The studentship can run up to four years with annual renewal based on progress and duties. The published 2026/27 rates are HK$19,100 monthly before the qualifying exam and HK$19,600 after it.
funding.quote: The postgraduate studentship is granted on the basis of academic merit.

also.quote: Continuation and renewal of the award are subject to satisfactory study progress, achievement in coursework results and performance in any academic-related duties assigned.
PhD students may be granted the studentship for a maximum of four years
the studentship Basic Rate is HK$19,100 per month (~US$2,440) and Advance Rate is HK$19,600 per month (~US$2,510).

entry_route.value: A first-class honours bachelor's degree or equivalent, a recognised master's degree, or a higher research degree can qualify. CityUHK MPhil transfer is a separate route.
entry_route.quote: hold a Bachelor's degree with first class honours (or equivalent qualification) from a recognised university.

also.quote: hold a Master's degree (or equivalent qualification) from a recognised university;

toefl_min.value: The College of Science general summary prints a legacy 79 as the sum of Reading, Listening and Writing. Its 2027/28 HKPFS instructions give 4.5 on the new scale or 79 legacy for the fellowship track. The department does not clarify the current normal-round calculation.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum total score of 79 (internet-based test; sum of Reading, Listening and Writing section scores) in TOEFL

also.quote: A score of 79 (for tests taken prior to 21 January 2026) or 4.5 (for tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards) (Internet-based Test) in the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL)

notes: Official research-degree catalogue: https://www.cityu.edu.hk/catalogue/pg/202627/programme/MA2_P.htm. The published regular-round TOEFL calculation remains unclear. The College of Science lists a three-section legacy score, while its 2027/28 fellowship guidance lists a single TOEFL iBT score of 4.5 on the new scale or 79 on the old scale.
